blocks.title: First words, questions and description
blocks.method: The opening lessons build meaning through pictures, concrete nouns, questions, answers, number, comparison and description.
outcomes: notice singular, plural and adjective agreement

blocks.title: Actions, people and connected scenes
blocks.method: The course expands from naming and description into actions, people, everyday situations and longer question-and-answer sequences.
outcomes: understand common verb forms in context
reuse model sentences with new vocabulary

blocks.title: Narration and wider everyday language
blocks.method: Readings and conversations become more sustained, with broader vocabulary and increasing use of past events, sequence and explanation.

blocks.title: Consolidation and extended reading
blocks.method: The final ten numbered lessons consolidate the direct-method progression through longer readings, practical language and increasingly independent response.
outcomes: give connected spoken and written answers
move into the book’s reference and supplementary sections
